faq.headline: What "start for €0" really means.
faq.subline: Keep the promise simple, but be clear about what is free inside MBC and what may cost money outside the platform.
faq.q1: Can I really start with MBC for €0?
faq.a1: Yes. The Creator profile is free to start. You can access the guided Creator experience without a subscription. AI usage limits can apply.
faq.q2: Does €0 mean every external business cost is free?
faq.a2: Starting on MBC is €0. However, third-party administrative or government costs (such as official commercial court registry filing fees with INPI / Guichet Unique in France, or legal notice publication fees) and optional third-party professional services are set by their respective institutions.
faq.q3: What happens when I reach my AI usage limit?
faq.a3: You can continue browsing, editing, and downloading all of your existing project files without any restriction. If you need to generate additional high-volume AI iterations or market deep-dives, you can purchase modular credit top-ups or upgrade your plan at any time.
faq.q4: Can I download what I create?
faq.a4: Yes. All generated assets—including your Brand Kit SVG icons, CSS token files, 12-chapter Executive Business Plan (PDF/HTML), Financial Forecast worksheets, and one-page website code—can be exported directly to your local device.
faq.q5: Will MBC register my company for me?
faq.a5: MBC automates the full preparation of your formation dossier (statutes, share capital deposit certificate instructions, declaration of non-conviction, NAF/APE activity selection). You can submit the dossier yourself via the official Guichet Unique portal or connect with a partner professional in our network to file on your behalf.
faq.q6: What happens to my project information?
faq.a6: Your ideas, venture information, and intellectual property belong 100% to you. We strictly encrypt all stored project data and will never share, sell, or train public models on your proprietary business details.
faq.q7: What is the future MBC network?
faq.a7: Beyond the Creator onboarding phase, MBC will connect your structured venture directly to Verified Entrepreneurs, Angel & Venture Capital Investors, and vetted Service Providers to help fund, operate, and scale your company.
